name: Chromatic Orb

header.Components: V, S, M (a diamond worth 50+ GP)

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Choose damage type; ranged spell attack; duplicate damage-die face causes a leap at chosen legal new target within 30 feet; no repeat creature, fresh attack/damage and leap cap equal paid slot; nonconsumed 50-GP diamond.

rules.text: You hurl an orb of energy at a target within range.
Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target.
On a hit, the target takes 3d8 damage of the chosen type.
If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the orb leaps to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target.
Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll.
The orb can’t leap again unless you cast the spell with a level 2+ spell slot.
The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 1.
The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended, and a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.
